review_candidates.title: Senior Information Technology Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The person in this role will manage and maintain network infrastructure, monitor system performance, and ensure secure and reliable connectivity across the organization. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing and resolving IT issues, implementing network security measures, coordinating with vendors and internal teams, and supporting upgrades, installations, and configurations of hardware and software. Qualifications Strong foundation in Information Technology, including systems administration
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Senior Information Technology Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Al Qalyubiyah, Egypt.
Ability to work on-site in Al Qalyubiyah, Egypt, and collaborate in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Strong foundation in Information Technology, including systems administration and IT operations. Hands-on experience with Network Administration, including configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of routers, switches, and related infrastructure. Proficiency in Troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues, with a systematic approach to root-cause analysis.
